versions.subject: feat: multiple updates and new rules (#4242)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\livekd.exe'
        - '\livekd64.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'livekd.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' /m'
        - ' -m'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\livekd.exe", "*\\livekd64.exe") OR OriginalFileName="livekd.exe" CommandLine="* /m*" CommandLine="* -m*"
